reviewMethod: Root independently actually read all 49 complete source POS/meanings/variants/evidence in bounded compact views, all 46 complete saved five-field bilingual pairs twice (second reading paired with full source meanings and variants), the entire author's notes and three individual authoring deferrals, final LOCK and compiled source hash. Judged selected senses, grammatical form, natural usage, translation fidelity and safe hypothetical technical contexts. Directly read Merriam-Webster Medical allotransplant transitive entry, Collins amidate conversion/inflections and MW anteriad definition; independently read indexed Collins nidus nest sense and nidal derivative, PubMed 10179588's complete indexed abstract establishing the symptoms/signs semiological branch, NCBI MeSH dental pulp capping and primary indexed research usages of capping exposed pulp. Direct PubMed request returned captcha, not claimed direct full-paper reading. No complete PDF or visual page review claimed. Ordinary compositional contexts and remaining source-grounded technical adjectives were manually read and judged, not falsely claimed all externally verified. Medical scenes are original diagrams/reviews/models, not clinical recommendations, diagnoses, protocols, efficacy or treatment claims. Amidated is correctly labelled a past participle in had amidated; hypomanic source wording is conservatively normalized to the same medical concept, not ordinary excitement; respirable does not imply safe inhalation. Albumenize inflections retain the coating branch, while separately deferred albuminize's biological conversion is not silently substituted. Allus, allo and albuminize remain explicit backlog, not invalidated or counted approved. No author edits or self-review; 46 independently judged pairs approved with no known substantive issues found, not an infallibility guarantee.
